en-US.name: Motrix URL Resolver
en-US.description: URL-resolver framework for Motrix. Ships no site-specific extractors; includes only a Wikimedia Commons demo resolver. Site resolution is provided by separately installed site-resolver plugins.
features: Base framework for site-specific media resolver plugins
Includes a Wikimedia Commons demo resolver
Preferred quality setting (1080p, 720p or 480p) shared with installed site resolvers
Supports direct-URL and split video/audio (mux) resolver results

zh-CN.name: Motrix URL 解析器
zh-CN.description: Motrix 的 URL 解析框架。不内置任何站点特定抽取器，仅含一个 Wikimedia Commons 演示解析器；站点解析由单独安装的 site-resolver 插件提供。
features: 站点媒体解析插件的基础框架
内置 Wikimedia Commons 演示解析器
首选清晰度设置（1080p / 720p / 480p），供已安装的 site-resolver 插件使用
支持直链与音视频分离（mux）两种解析结果
